title: Design System: Kimi Work 网关控制面板

display.purpose: The single page title. Never used for section headings.

label.purpose: Control text, hints, values in ruled rows.

micro.purpose: Uppercase section labels and readout captions at the 11px floor.

mono.purpose: Identifiers, URLs, token counts, timestamps. Never prose.

shadows.name: toast-lift
shadows.purpose: The only floating element in the panel: a transient status toast.

shadows.name: toast-alert-ring
shadows.purpose: Error toast: a ring stands in for a border so elevation stays single-layer.

shadows.name: tick-doubled
shadows.purpose: Doubles the 3px emission tick of the selected model row without adding width.

shadows.name: primary-doubled-rule
shadows.purpose: The primary button's doubled hairline, cut from the plate colour.

motion.name: ease-state
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and colour transitions at 140ms.

motion.name: ease-out-soft
motion.purpose: Layout shifts and the calibration band's mark travel at 480–520ms.

motion.name: skeleton-sweep
motion.purpose: The loading skeleton's single sweep. No spinner.

motion.name: press-nudge
motion.purpose: Buttons press down by one pixel; nothing scales.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one committing action on the plate: apply the drafted target. Doubled hairline, arrow on the trailing edge.

components.css: .ds-registers { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(0,1fr); border-top: 1px solid #1f2123; border-bottom: 1px solid #1f2123; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-register { display: grid; gap: 5px; align-content: start; padding: 14px 0 15px; } .ds-register-right { text-align: right; justify-items: end; } .ds-micro { margin: 0; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: #8b877f; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-register-value { margin: 0; font: 400 20px/1.25 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #eae6dd; word-break: normal; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-register-right .ds-register-value { color: #b3aea4; } .ds-register-sub { margin: 0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; color: #8b877f; } .ds-verdict { display: grid; justify-items: center; align-content: center; gap: 3px; padding: 12px 20px; background: #0d0e0f; border-left: 1px solid #1f2123; border-right: 1px solid #1f2123; text-align: center; color: #8b877f; } .ds-verdict-mark { margin-bottom: 3px; } .ds-verdict-word { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: inherit; } .ds-verdict-note { margin: 0; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.45; color: #8b877f; max-width: 30ch; }

components.name: Model Row
components.description: One catalogue entry: emission tick, mono id, capability flags in tabular columns. Selected recesses and the tick doubles in sodium.

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Catalogue filter. The field is its own focus ring; the caret is sodium.
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-search svg { position: absolute; left: 9px; color: #8b877f; pointer-events: none; } .ds-search-input { width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 0 30px 0 31px; border: 1px solid #2a2c2e; border-radius: 0; background: #0d0e0f; color: #eae6dd; caret-color: #f0c352; font: 400 12px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; transition: border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1); } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: #807c74; opacity: 1; } .ds-search-input:hover { border-color: #45484b; } .ds-search-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #f0c352; }

components.name: State Mark
components.description: The seven line forms that carry state. Solid = live, dashed = pending, half = stale, struck = blocked, doubled = saved, capped = adopted, conflicting = disagreement.
components.html: livependingstaleblockedsavedadopted
components.css: .ds-marks { display: flex; gap: 18px; flex-wrap: wrap; font: 400 12px/1.4 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; color: #8b877f; } .ds-mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; } .ds-mark svg { color: #eae6dd; flex: none; } .ds-mark:nth-child(2) svg { color: #8b877f; } .ds-mark:nth-child(4) svg { color: #e8736b; } .ds-mark:nth-child(5) svg { color: #f0c352; } .ds-mark:nth-child(6) svg { color: #f0c352; }

narrative.overview: The panel is one instrument plate calibrated against a single off-centre rail. It is not a settings dashboard. There is one continuum, one rail, one binding strip, and the whole surface is read the way you read a spectrograph: by line form, not by colour. The product's one hard truth is that a saved choice and an adopted runtime are different facts. Most control panels blur them into a single "current setting" row. Here they sit as two registers on the same horizontal rule, with a verdict between them, so the difference is structural rather than explained.
keyCharacteristics: Colour survives only as seven hairline emission lines (405/436/486/546/589/615/656 nm) used for measurement, never decoration.
State is carried by line height, dash, doubling, capping, and strike-through — not hue.
Structure is drawn, not boxed: 1px hairlines, corner registration ticks, ruled groups.
One grotesque at one size, ranked by tracking and ink; monospace only for identifiers, URLs, numbers, and timestamps.
Square corners everywhere. No radii, no pills, no cards.

rules.name: The Emission-Only Rule
rules.body: Colour may not encode state. If a mark needs to say "pending", "adopted", "blocked", or "conflicting", it says it in line form. Hue is reserved for identity (which model) and for the single accent (which target).

rules.name: The Two-Register Rule
rules.body: A saved value and an observed value never share one cell. If they must appear near each other, they are separated by a rule and a verdict word.

rules.name: The 11px Floor
rules.body: Functional text never goes below 11px; only non-interactive legal smallprint may. The band tags and readout captions sit exactly on the floor.

rules.name: The Tracking-Not-Size Rule
rules.body: Rank within the micro tier comes from tracking (0.14em) and ink, not from shrinking the type.

rules.name: The Drawn-Not-Boxed Rule
rules.body: If a boundary is needed, it is a hairline. Never a border plus a shadow on the same element.

dos: Carry every state in line form first; add the word second.
Keep the saved register and the adopted register physically separate, always.
Use mono only for identifiers, URLs, numbers, and timestamps.
Keep the calibration band honest: every mark must correspond to a real catalogue value.
Let the rail carry system facts; let the plate carry the task.
donts: Don't tint a state green/amber/red. Hue is for identity and the one accent.
Don't show the policy as if it were the runtime's observation.
Don't add a card, a pill, a radius, or a drop shadow to create hierarchy.
Don't decorate with stripes, grids, or grain; a texture must come from a measuring tool that is actually present.
Don't render the panel key, any credential, or raw configuration anywhere in the DOM.
